name: hds-redteam
description: Draft and red-team proposal-style documents. /draft writes a PRD (개요 / 유저 스토리 / 스토리별 요구사항) that flags its own assumptions; /redteam runs four parallel critics — logic, technical, UX/audience, business risk — across five domain modes (-prd, -sec, -rfc, -biz, default) and outputs a self-contained HTML dashboard with concrete scenarios, external citations, confidence scores, and falsification conditions.
